To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
artificial intelligence is a global phenomenon and the ethos of its legal personality is influenced by the ethos of the globalized space.

the ethos of artificial intelligence as legal personality is traceable and can be protected by the due regard and scope to the four constitutive approaches, which are anthropomorphisation, naturalization, techno socialization and enculturation.

the legal persona of artificial intelligence needs to be determined and defined based on the ethos and structure of artificial intelligence in a post liberal order and the ethos of artificial intelligence can be protected and defined in a globalized space by adapting to the identity led and anthropomorphic implications of artificial intelligence.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the legal personality of artificial intelligence, which is based on the ethos, which is traceable and is influenced by the legal infrastructure and the legal persona of the AI, which in turn is influenced by the deterministic mechanisms of the legal infrastructure and its due scope of the legal persona of artificial intelligence.
the ethos of the legal personality and identity of artificial intelligence in a globalized space.
the ethos of artificial intelligence as the legal personality in the globalized space.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ethos of artificial intelligence as legal personality is capable of a dynamic and stable interpretation in the global space by adapting the constitutive approaches of anthropomorphisation, naturalization, techno socialization and enculturation.

the ethos of AI as a legal personality can be protected and developed by the four approaches in the post liberal order, thereby, giving a reasonable and constitutive space for AI to develop and grow in a globalized space, while, at the same time, protecting its identity and ethos in a post liberal world.
the legal personality of artificial intelligence in a post liberal technological order is traceable and can be protected by adapting to the ethos of globalization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

in the case that the ethos of AI is to be protected and diversified, it is necessary to give adequate and reasonable space to identity led implications of nationalism in the globalized space, diluting the monopolized influence of the utilitarist approach to AI.

the ethos of AI in the post liberal order is traceable to the globalized space, which is a challenge for the legal personality of the AI, and thus the paper is based on the proposition to understand the legal personality of artificial intelligence by adapting to the ethos of the globalized space.
the legal personality of artificial intelligence is a complex and dynamic phenomenon which is influenced by the ethos of globalization.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the ethos of artificial intelligence can be protected and preserved in the age of the post liberal order by the appreciation of the identity led implications, which are the basis of the ethos of artificial Intelligence in a globalized space.

the ethos of artificial intelligence as an autonomous legal person can be protected in the post liberal order, by the adaptation of the legal personality with the appreciation of globalization, giving space for the national identity and diluting the monopolies of the utilitarian approaches to artificial intelligence.

AI is capable of a legal personality and the legal infrastructure of AI is capable of being traced and understood by the legal system of any country, but the challenge lies in the fact that the legal system of the countries is not capable of understanding the dynamic, transformative nature of AI, and thus, it is important to have the legal infrastructure and the legal personality of the artificial intelligence to be understood and traced by the legal system.
